objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation code for the document type used in naming convention.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of applicability of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period defining how long a document remains valid before requiring a validity check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies to which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas or regions where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons automatically informed by email upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content, relevant for translation management.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and has no own release cycle, used for non-critical supplementary information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning, triggering a new version of the main document upon creation, modification, or archiving.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors to suggest changes to an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity, triggering archiving of the document and its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users in the system used to assign read and change authorizations to documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process defined in process management to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data objects such as IT applications that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document containing user groups and persons who are informed about document releases.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the steps of document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature used by workflow participants to complete their tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluations for the logged-in user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation providing filtered results based on selection parameters and criteria.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.
